title: Feature Posts Get Real Video on LinkedIn and Facebook | vitalii.no
description:
Every feature on this site already ships with its own short demo clip. But the daily social post announcing a new feature could only carry plain text, or text with a static screenshot -- the actual video sitting right there in the database never made it onto LinkedIn or Facebook. Uploading it by hand for every single post wasn't something that scales at the pace features ship.

postToLinkedIn and postToFacebook inside the nano-social-publish Supabase Edge Function (supabase/functions/nano-social-publish/index.ts) now accept an optional video URL. For LinkedIn, it registers the upload against the feedshare-video recipe, pushes the video bytes to the returned URL (rejecting anything over 50MB), then polls the asset status every 5 seconds for up to 120 seconds before publishing. For Facebook, it posts straight to the page's /videos endpoint with the file URL, letting Facebook pull the file itself. Either path falls back to the existing text, or text-plus-image, post if the video upload fails.

Feature posts can now show the real demo clip playing in-feed on LinkedIn and Facebook instead of a static screenshot -- and if a video upload ever fails, the post still goes out as text instead of being lost entirely.
